
EXPORT-DEPENDENCIES
Export dependency graph visualization in various formats

USAGE
  fspec export-dependencies <format> <output>

ARGUMENTS
  <format> (required)
    Output format: dot, mermaid, or json
  <output> (required)
    Output file path

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Export as Mermaid diagram
  $ fspec export-dependencies mermaid dependencies.mmd
  ✓ Exported dependencies to dependencies.mmd

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-dependency
  fspec query-dependency-stats
